# Skillet

> Build agent skills from a reviewable spec, with optional evals for selected behavior.

Skillet keeps the required spec and agent instructions reviewable. Eval cases are a separate opt-in for scenarios worth measuring; ordinary authoring does not create or run them.

- [Documentation](/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/getsentry/skillet)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sentry/skillet)

## Install the Authoring Skill

When asked to install Skillet globally for an agent:

1. Install `skills/skillet-authoring` from `https://github.com/getsentry/skillet` in user scope.
2. Prefer `npx -y @sentry/dotagents@latest --user add getsentry/skillet skillet-authoring`.
3. Do not create project-local skill files or modify the current repository.
4. After installation, run Skillet commands through `npx -y @sentry/skillet@latest` or `pnpx @sentry/skillet@latest`.
5. If installation fails, report the failure instead of changing the source or scope.

The latest `skillet status` checks the standard user-scoped installation for a stale authoring contract. When stale, follow `status.next`: reinstall through its scoped dotagents command or the same method that originally installed it, then rerun status before continuing. To continue in the same session, read the reinstalled SKILL.md first; otherwise start a new session. Skillet never silently rewrites user configuration. Custom installation locations require manual reinstallation through their original method.
